growth_experiences: 大约六个月前，在现居地持续尝试建立友谊受挫：每当参加本地活动或社团，常感到像局外人、紧张羞怯，主观体验为“被忽视”、难以被注意和接纳，导致Loneliness感加重。
几个月前参加社区艺术课时，感到他人已有固定小圈子，自己“很透明”，尽管尝试加入话题仍not yet能建立更深入的联系；仅有一次与一位Female围绕喜爱的Artist进行的自然、愉快的交谈，但not yet进一步延续为稳定关系。

core_beliefs: 我not具备结交朋友的能力

special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 只有离开这里我才可能交到朋友；如果not离开，就会一直这样

Reduces participation and proactive attempts, using self-endurance to avoid possible rejection

exception_events.reason: Clue: based on shared interests and familiar topics (art) the social load was reduced; the classroom atmosphere in a shared context was safer; the client at the time tried to open a conversation around the common ground.

positive_force: Shared interests and professional field (art) can serve as a social bridge

When facing strangers or unfamiliar small circles
